FREE Coasters for Cape Cod Bars & Restaurants
You Pour the Drinks. We’ll Supply the Coasters.

blocks.html:
Cape Cod Cannabis offers free bar coasters for restaurants, bars and hospitality businesses throughout Cape Cod. Our professionally designed coasters are complimentary, delivered directly to participating establishments and available at no cost to your business. We currently deliver our coasters to many restaurants on Cape Cod…and they LOVE them!

Our professionally designed coasters feature Cape Cod coastal imagery, Wellfleet branding and responsible adult-use messaging while providing a practical coaster for your tables and bar service — at absolutely no cost to your business.

We’ll even deliver them directly to you. Or you can stop by and pick them up (based on availability).

FREE COASTERS • FREE DELIVERY • NO COST TO PARTICIPATE

blocks.text: Free Coaster Delivery
No cost. No pickup. No hassle.

blocks.html:
This isn’t a one-time giveaway. Cape Cod Cannabis will deliver a fresh supply of complimentary coasters to participating establishments four times each year, timed around some of Cape Cod’s busiest weekends:

Memorial Day Weekend • Fourth of July • Labor Day Weekend • Wellfleet Oyster Fest

We’ll coordinate delivery directly to your establishment, so there’s no need to pick them up or remember to reorder before these key holiday weekends.

Hosting a special local event or running low between deliveries?
Additional coasters and deliveries available upon request. (based on availability)

blocks.text: Get Free Coasters for Your Business

blocks.html:
The Cape Cod Cannabis Hospitality Coaster Program is available to appropriate restaurants, bars and hospitality establishments throughout Cape Cod.

Getting started is easy. Tell us about your business and approximately how many coasters you typically need. Our team will contact you to confirm participation, quantities and delivery details.

We welcome establishments throughout Wellfleet, Eastham, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, Brewster, Chatham, Harwich, Dennis, Yarmouth, Hyannis and other Cape Cod communities.

blocks.html: Conveniently located on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary is an easy stop for anyone traveling to or from Provincetown, Eastham, Wellfleet, Truro, Orleans, Brewster, Hyannis or just off Cape in Plymouth. Whether you’re exploring the Cape’s beaches, biking the Rail Trail, or heading back from a day at the National Seashore, our dispensary is a quick and convenient stop for all your cannabis needs.

items.q: How often will you deliver coasters?

blocks.html: Cape Cod Cannabis plans three deliveries each year, typically before Memorial Day Weekend, the Fourth of July and Labor Day Weekend. Additional deliveries may be available for special local events or when more coasters are needed, based on availability.

items.q: Do we have to pick them up?

blocks.html:
No. We’ll coordinate delivery directly to participating Cape Cod restaurants, bars and hospitality businesses.

But you can visit Cape Cod Cannabis and check us out, if you haven’t been here before. Note: Visitors must be 21+ years of age with a valid government-issued ID.

items.q: What if we need more coasters?

blocks.html: Just contact Jim @ (774) 383-3133 to schedule. Additional coasters may be available between scheduled deliveries while supplies last (based on availability)!
